title: Seacrest Beach "Lost Shaker of Salt" 8718 E County Hwy 30A Unit A
h1: Seacrest Beach "Lost Shaker of Salt" 8718 E County Hwy 30A Unit A
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Gulf-front- Gulf views- Shared pool- 2 designated parking spots (overflow parking first come first serve outside of gate)- Spacious beach area - Short walk to Rosemary and Alys Beach shopping and dining- Complimentary beach service provided from May- October (2 chairs, 1 umbrella, and 1 side table)- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Accommodating up to 16 guests in an expansive 5-bedroom, 4-bathroom layout, Lost Shaker of Salt is a 3,400-square-foot, Gulf-front condo along Scenic 30A. Nestled within the highly desirable Seacrest Beach community, guests will love stepping outside to the shared pool and following the boardwalk off the back deck to spacious beach access. Rosemary and Alys Beach are a short walk away for exceptional shopping and dining!This single-story condo was designed with comfort and elegance in mind—including updated furniture and décor. A gourmet kitchen featuring granite countertops, designer cabinets, and high-end appliances has everything for a home-cooked meal. The open dining area seats 10 with a wet bar nearby, while counter seating can accommodate 4 more—great for hosting! The living area boasts comfortable furnishings with posh finishes and an impressive 75" TV. The travertine floors and 12-foot ceilings lend an air of grandeur to this immaculate space. French doors lead to a spacious outdoor haven perfect for lounging, entertaining, and soaking up the breathtaking Gulf views. Outdoor seating for 6 around a table beckons guests to dine alfresco next to sparkling Gulf waters. The community pool area is steps away, as is the expansive beach area with sugar-soft Emerald Coast sands—enjoy more space here than in other beach areas! Take a dip in the turquoise waters of the Gulf in the morning, then lounge poolside in the afternoon. Rinse sandy feet off in the outdoor shower before heading inside for evening cocktails with loved ones. When it's time to retire, guests can pick from 5 spacious bedrooms—3 guest bedrooms with king beds and 55" TVs, 1 custom bunk room with 2 built-in queen-over-queen beds and a private bathroom, and 1 primary bedroom with a king bed, private bathroom, and porch access that leads to the pool.Lost Shaker of Salt has everything for those seeking the best Gulf Coast experience. With 2 designated parking spots and overflow parking outside the gate, it's easy to explore the area. Don't miss the opportunity to unwind at this extraordinary getaway. Book Lost Shaker of Salt today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTSFIRST FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub Separate - Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Jack-N-Jill Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Jack-N-Jill Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: Two Queen-over-Queen Bunk beds, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo*Weddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments as well as be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines
